scope: Bump release version to 3.0.0-beta.1, configure pure keyless OIDC Trusted Publishing without registry-url in setup-node, and validate the pending Trusted Publisher configuration on npm

tasks.title: Bump Package Version to 3.0.0-beta.1
tasks.description: Update version to '3.0.0-beta.1' in package.json (and package-lock.json / docs-site/package.json if applicable) so npm accepts the new release and does not reject with 409 Conflict.

tasks.title: Refactor publish-npm-registry for Pure Keyless OIDC Publishing
tasks.description: Fix .github/workflows/publish.yml: (1) In 'publish-npm-registry', remove 'registry-url' from actions/setup-node to stop it from generating an auth-token-demanding ~/.npmrc, (2) Remove all NODE_AUTH_TOKEN and secrets.NPM_TOKEN environment declarations, (3) Ensure top-level/job permissions have 'id-token: write' and 'contents: read', (4) Execute 'npm publish "$TARBALL_PATH" --tag "$DIST_TAG" --access public --provenance' directly against npm.

tasks.title: Validate Clean Build, Tarball Packaging & Linting
tasks.description: Run local checks: verify 'npm run lint', 'npm test', 'npm run build', and 'npm pack --dry-run' to ensure the tarball contains node-pptx-templater-3.0.0-beta.1.tgz with zero test regressions.

tasks.title: Update Documentation, CHANGELOG & Workspace Memory
tasks.description: Update CHANGELOG.md for 3.0.0-beta.1 and synchronize .agent/project_summary.md with the keyless OIDC Trusted Publishing pipeline status.
